definitions.explanation: The state of being unmarried. Can be used as a noun or as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{独身|どくしん}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{独身|どくしん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんで→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{独身|どくしん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {独身|どくしん} is a neutral term for being unmarried. It doesn't carry the same negative connotations that 'single' sometimes does in English.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {独身|どくしん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (to be single)
- {独身|どくしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (single ~)
- {独身|どくしん}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (single life)
- {独身|どくしん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (single days/era)
- {独身|どくしん}⟦{貴族|きぞく}→貴族：17414_kizoku⟧ (single aristocrat - term for carefree singles)
- {独身|どくしん}⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧ (singles' dormitory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既婚|きこん}→既婚：16160_kikon⟧ (married)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{未婚|みこん}→未婚：14933_mikon⟧ (unmarried - formal)
- ⟦シングル→シングル：10949_shinguru⟧ (single - loanword)
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (marriage)
- ⟦バツイチ→バツイチ：11119_batsuichi⟧ (divorced once - colloquial)
